text: No thermal detections were confirmed for the covered period (October 13–November 12, 2026), based on NASA FIRMS data. However, there was a temporal gap in coverage from November 2–6 due to data unavailability for the VIIRS_SNPP sensor. All other sensors (VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, MODIS) had continuous coverage, and no detections were recorded during their operational periods.
